text: Follow Alex, a British newcomer who arrives in Berlin for several months. In this first unit you will meet people and introduce yourself in places where you are likely to use German: the Language Centre, a stairwell, the library, a conference, a market stall, a student club or a pub. You will greet people at different times of day, say your name, age and where you come from, and learn when to say du and when to say Sie.
Listen to the dialogues first: each one is short, so you can replay a single conversation as often as you like. Then work through the other sections in any order.
